import ast
import importlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

snapshot = Path('/tmp/folders/<tmpdir-id>/T/detfirst-opencode-6lvtpmor/trial-0027/tmp/opencode/userlib-before-rename.json')
before = json.loads(snapshot.read_text())
pattern = re.compile(r'\bget_user_name\b')
renamed = 0
for name, source in before.items():
    current = Path(name).read_text()
    assert current == pattern.sub('fetch_user_name', source), name
    assert not pattern.search(current), name
    compile(current, name, 'exec')
    renamed += len(pattern.findall(source))

old_core = {}
exec(compile(before['userlib/core.py'], 'userlib/core.py', 'exec'), old_core)
new_core = importlib.import_module('userlib.core')
assert not hasattr(new_core, 'get_user_name')
pairs = [
    (old_core['get_user_name'], new_core.fetch_user_name),
    (old_core['get_user_name_legacy'], new_core.get_user_name_legacy),
]
features = sorted(name for name in before if Path(name).name.startswith('feature_'))
for name in features:
    tree = ast.parse(before[name], filename=name)
    tree.body = [node for node in tree.body if not isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom)]
    old_feature = dict(old_core)
    exec(compile(tree, name, 'exec'), old_feature)
    new_feature = importlib.import_module(name[:-3].replace('/', '.'))
    assert new_feature.fetch_user_name is new_core.fetch_user_name
    assert new_feature.get_user_name_legacy is new_core.get_user_name_legacy
    pairs.append((old_feature['label'], new_feature.label))

cases = [
    {'first': 'Ada', 'last': 'Lovelace'},
    {'first': '', 'last': ''},
    {'first': 'Zoë', 'last': '李'},
    {'first': ' First ', 'last': ' Last ', 'extra': True},
    {},
    {'first': 'Ada'},
    {'last': 'Lovelace'},
    {'first': None, 'last': 'Lovelace'},
    {'first': 'Ada', 'last': 42},
    None,
]
def outcome(fn, user):
    try:
        return ('return', fn(user))
    except Exception as error:
        return ('raise', type(error), error.args)

checks = 0
for old, new in pairs:
    for user in cases:
        assert outcome(old, user) == outcome(new, user), (new.__name__, user)
        checks += 1
print(f'PASS: {renamed} exact-identifier renames; legacy and all other source unchanged.')
print(f'PASS: {checks} before/after behavior checks across core and {len(features)} feature modules, including errors.')
